title: EvoAl memory model: execution information
description: Written once before iteration 0, when the definitions of the run are complete (ExecutionRecorder.beginExecution). Describes the problem, the configuration of the algorithm and the statistics writers, the spaces and the metrics of the run.

distance.description: Target goals only: measures how far an objective value is from the target.

function.description: The configuration of the optimisation function that maps the search space to the optimisation space ('map with' in OL).

algorithm.description: The configuration of the algorithm, e.g. of the type 'de.evoal.optimisation.local_search.optimisation.local-search', with all its attributes.

documentation.description: The configurations of the statistics writers in the order they are used: those of the problem, then those of the algorithm block.

citations.description: The BibTeX keys of the literature of the configuration, in the order of citations.bib in the output folder: the EvoAl paper, then the sources of the DL types and DDL declarations the configuration uses and the citations of their plugins and libraries.

fitness.description: How the fitness of the individuals is computed from their output. The direction step (minimise: v, maximise: -v, target: the goal's distance) always runs first and follows from the goals, so it is not listed in 'steps'.

components.description: The components of the fitness, in the order of the fitness values of the individuals.

goal.description: The objective of the goal the component was derived from; missing for components without a goal.

steps.description: The steps configured in 'fitness-pipeline', in the order in which they run after the direction step.

metricDefinitions.description: All metrics of the run, in definition order.

propertyDefinitions.description: All properties of the individuals and relationships of the run, in definition order. Missing if there are none.

setup.description: What is needed, besides the configuration files and the target file, to repeat the run.

evoalVersion.description: Version of EvoAl that executed the run, e.g. '2027.4.0'.

seed.description: Seed of the EvoAl execution (core:seed), the same for all of its runs. A decimal string, since the 64-bit value exceeds the integers that every JSON reader represents exactly.

run.description: Index of the run within the EvoAl execution, counted over all repetitions and targets. The random numbers of the run are derived from seed, run and the name of the requesting component.

repetition.description: Index of the repetition for the current target; only in the evaluation setup.

target.description: Index of the target point; only in the evaluation setup with a target file.

reproducibility.description: The components whose results may not be reproducible on other platforms, even with the same seed, e.g. because they use native numeric libraries. Missing if the run is fully reproducible.

component.description: Name of the component, e.g. a fitness step.

reason.description: Why the results of the component may differ between platforms.
